members.name: tvg_swcanvas_create
members.brief: Creates a new Software Canvas object with optional rendering engine settings.
description: This method generates a software canvas instance that can be used for drawing vector graphics. It accepts an optional parameter `op` to choose between different rendering engine behaviors.

members.name: tvg_swcanvas_set_target
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_swcanvas_set_target(Tvg_Canvas canvas, uint32_t* buffer, uint32_t stride, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, Tvg_Colorspace cs)
members.brief: Sets the buffer used in the rasterization process and defines the used colorspace.
description: For optimisation reasons TVG does not allocate memory for the output buffer on its own. The buffer of a desirable size should be allocated and owned by the caller.

params.name: buffer
params.description: The allocated memory block of the size `stride` x `h`.

params.name: stride
params.description: The stride of the raster image - in most cases same value as `w`.

params.name: w
params.description: The width of the raster image.

params.name: h
params.description: The height of the raster image.

params.name: cs
params.description: The colorspace value defining the way the 32-bits colors should be read/written.

retvals.description: An invalid canvas or buffer pointer passed or one of the `stride`, `w` or `h` being zero.
if the canvas is performing rendering. Please ensure the canvas is synced.
The software engine is not supported.

notes: Currently, only `TVG_COLORSPACE_ABGR8888`, `TVG_COLORSPACE_ARGB8888`, `TVG_COLORSPACE_ABGR8888S`, and `TVG_COLORSPACE_ARGB8888S` are supported for `cs`.
warnings: Do not access `buffer` during tvg_canvas_draw() - tvg_canvas_sync(). It should not be accessed while the engine is writing on it.
